svg.text: Control architecture of the crankcase FMS cell – line PLC-01 (twin example, real IP plan 10.51.0.x)
One line PLC (fail-safe CPU) coordinates 5 stations. Machines with own controllers (CNC) talk to it over PROFINET; safety devices over PROFIsafe.
Plant Ethernet – OPC UA tcp/4840, S7 engineering, NTP
central I/O = line signals: main switch, PSU OK, reset,
X2 → plant / OPC UA server, web server OFF
MRP ring closing segment (dashed) – one cable break is tolerated, reconfiguration ≤ 200 ms
Safety devices (2-channel, test pulses) → F-modules → PROFIsafe in the same PROFINET telegram:
CPU, central + distributed I/O, safety, HMI, networks
